data_role: already viewed development; not held out
change: Only fit applies bounded Armijo backtracking on frozen reciprocal correspondences plus unchanged nonlinear transported marginal prior
raw_cost: Sum Huber(r,0.01m), including every admitted reciprocal sample; no re-association during candidate trials
prior_cost: 0.5*delta^T H_prior delta + g_prior^T delta with original nonlinear chart; additive constant immaterial
association: Original per-iteration reciprocal selection, at least200 per pair, fixed within search; recomputed for next linearization and final gates
convergence: Unscaled full solve below strict 1e-5m and 1e-5rad for all nonorigin nodes
trace_delta: Full unscaled proposal; applied alpha and all cost trials recorded separately
exhausted_search: Reject entire fit; no partial state commit, no coarse skip for exhausted search
